title: IO-Link
summary: IO-Link is a point-to-point communication for sensors and actuators over standard unshielded cables, standardized as IEC 61131-9 (SDCI).

sections.heading: Key ideas
sections.body: An IO-Link master port connects one device. The device can work as a plain switching sensor or exchange process data, parameters and diagnostics. IODD files describe devices; parameter servers allow automatic re-parameterization after replacement.

sections.heading: Typical faults
sections.body: Wrong port mode (digital input instead of IO-Link), device replaced with a different variant, parameter server conflicts.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: PLC Lab does not simulate this protocol and claims no conformance or interoperability. Port modes, IODD files and parameter servers are not modeled. PLC Lab's sensors are plain switching devices, as an IO-Link device behaves in digital input mode; an inverted switching function is practiced in `ts.part-sensor-inverted`.
